items.source: This should be pre-configured with the Environment (if desired) but not with a BeanNameGenerator or ScopeMetadataResolver yet.
items.translation: 这应该已预配置了 `Environment`（如需要），但尚未配置 `BeanNameGenerator` 或 `ScopeMetadataResolver`。

items.translation: beanFactory - 用于加载 Bean 定义的 Bean Factory

items.source: This is essentially the equivalent of AnnotationConfigApplicationContext for a web environment. However, in contrast to AnnotationConfigApplicationContext, this class does not extend GenericApplicationContext and therefore does not provide some of the convenient registerBean(...) methods available in a GenericApplicationContext. If you wish to register annotated component classes with a GenericApplicationContext in a web environment, you may use a GenericWebApplicationContext with an AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader. See the Javadoc for GenericWebApplicationContext for details and an example.
items.translation: 这本质上相当于 Web 环境中的 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext。然而，与 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext 不同，该类不继承 GenericApplicationContext，因此不提供 GenericApplicationContext 中可用的某些便捷方法，如 registerBean(...)。如果您希望在 Web 环境中使用 GenericApplicationContext 注册带注解的 组件类，可以使用带有 AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader 的 GenericWebApplicationContext。有关详细信息和示例，请参阅 GenericWebApplicationContext 的 Javadoc。

items.source: As an alternative to setting the "contextConfigLocation" parameter, users may implement an ApplicationContextInitializer and set the "contextInitializerClasses" context-param / init-param. In such cases, users should favor the AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() and scan(String...) methods over the AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext.setConfigLocation(String) method, which is primarily for use by ContextLoader.
items.translation: 作为设置"contextConfigLocation"参数的替代方案，用户可以实现一个ApplicationContextInitializer并设置"contextInitializerClasses"。在这种情况下，用户应优先使用AbstractApplicationContext.refresh()和scan(String...)方法，而不是主要用于ContextLoader的AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext.setConfigLocation(String)方法。

items.source: Unlike XmlWebApplicationContext, no default configuration class locations are assumed. Rather, it is a requirement to set the "contextConfigLocation" context-param for ContextLoader and/or "contextConfigLocation" init-param for FrameworkServlet. The param-value may contain both fully-qualified class names and base packages to scan for components. See loadBeanDefinitions(DefaultListableBeanFactory) for exact details on how these locations are processed.
items.translation: 与XmlWebApplicationContext不同，不会假设任何默认的配置类位置。相反，必须为ContextLoader设置"contextConfigLocation" context-param，和/或为 FrameworkServlet 设置"contextConfigLocation" init-param。参数值可以包含完全限定的类名以及用于扫描组件的基础包。有关这些位置处理方式的详细信息，请参阅loadBeanDefinitions(DefaultListableBeanFactory)。

items.source: For any values specified by AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext.setConfigLocation(String) or AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext.setConfigLocations(String[]), attempt first to load each location as a class, registering a BeanDefinition if class loading is successful, and if class loading fails (i.e. a ClassNotFoundException is raised), assume the value is a package and attempt to scan it for component classes.
items.translation: 对于由 `AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext.setConfigLocation(String)` 或 AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext.setConfigLocations(String[]) 指定的任何值，首先尝试将每个位置加载为类；如果类加载成功，则注册一个 `BeanDefinition`；如果类加载失败（即抛出 `ClassNotFoundException`），则假设该值为包名，并尝试扫描该包以查找组件类。

items.source: This class may also be directly instantiated and injected into Spring's DispatcherServlet or ContextLoaderListener when using the WebApplicationInitializer code-based alternative to web.xml. See its Javadoc for details and usage examples.
items.translation: 该类也可以直接实例化，并在使用 `WebApplicationInitializer` 代码替代方案时，直接注入到 Spring 的DispatcherServlet或ContextLoaderListener中。有关详细信息和使用示例，请参阅其 Javadoc。

items.source: Note: In case of multiple @Configuration classes, later @Bean definitions will override ones defined in earlier loaded files. This can be leveraged to deliberately override certain bean definitions via an extra @Configuration class.
items.translation: 注意：如果有多个 `@Configuration` 类，后加载的 `@Bean` 定义将覆盖先前文件中定义的 Bean。可以利用这一点，通过额外的 `@Configuration` 类来故意覆盖某些 Bean 定义。

items.translation: 默认值为 `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator`。

items.translation: 默认值为一个 `AnnotationScopeMetadataResolver`。

items.source: To make use of this application context, the "contextClass" context-param for ContextLoader and/or "contextClass" init-param for FrameworkServlet must be set to the fully-qualified name of this class.
items.translation: 要使用此应用程序上下文，必须将 ContextLoader 的 `"contextClass"` context-param 和/或 FrameworkServlet 的 "contextClass" init-param 设置为该类的完全限定名。

items.source: Enables the default set of annotation configuration post processors, such that @Autowired and associated annotations can be used.
items.translation: 启用默认的一组注解配置后置处理器，以便可以使用 `@Autowired` 及相关注解。

items.source: Configuration class bean definitions are registered with generated bean definition names unless the value attribute is provided to the stereotype annotation.
items.translation: 配置类 Bean 定义会注册为生成的 Bean 定义名称，除非在立体注解中提供了`value`属性。

items.source:
Allows for registering classes one by one (specifying class names as config
locations) as well as via classpath scanning (specifying base packages as config
locations).
items.translation: 允许逐个注册类（将类名指定为配置位置）以及通过类路径扫描注册类（将基础包指定为配置位置）。

items.source: Register a BeanDefinition for any classes specified by register(Class...) and scan any packages specified by scan(String...).
items.translation: 为 `BeanDefinition` 注册任何由 `register(Class...)` 指定的类，并扫描由 `scan(String...)` 指定的任何包。

items.source: Set a custom BeanNameGenerator for use with AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader and/or ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner.
items.translation: 为 `AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader` 和/或 `ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner` 设置自定义的用于使用的BeanNameGenerator。

items.source: Set a custom ScopeMetadataResolver for use with AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader and/or ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner.
items.translation: 为 `AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader` 和/或 `ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner` 设置一个自定义的 `ScopeMetadataResolver`。

items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 工厂构建一个AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader。

items.translation: 为给定的 BeanFactory 构建一个ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner。
